paragraphs: “Rav Chiyya bar Ashi said that Shmuel said” — Hyman reports this as the reading of the Rif and Dikdukei Soferim in Pesachim 30b; the text he uses reads Rava bar Abba.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading supplies the transmitter whose report begins “Rav Chiyya bar Ashi said that Shmuel said.” The William Davidson digital text of Pesachim 30b has Rava bar Abba as that transmitter. Hyman reports Chanan son of Rav Yitzchak for the Rif/Dikdukei Soferim reading; these alternatives are not merged.

The saved whole William Davidson Pesachim 30b scalar has Rava bar Abba reporting Rav Chiyya bar Ashi in the name of Shmuel. The source heading fully writes Rav Chanan son of Rav Yitzchak; the Rif and Dikdukei Soferim alternatives remain Hyman’s reports, without fresh collation or merger of the transmitters.
